name: ameltech-youtube-class
description: Subject-specific YouTube video and notes-PDF matching for every heading in study material, plus beginner-friendly Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266 project guides.

interface.longDescription: Two skills in one plugin. (1) Study material: upload PDF, PPT, PPTX, or DOCX and every meaningful heading is matched separately, with or without a request, to a YouTube learning video, a direct cartoon or animated video link, and a direct online notes PDF link, all checked for close title and subject match. (2) Maker projects: ask for any Arduino, ESP32, or ESP8266 project, or upload your code or circuit diagram, and get an error-checked design with a parts list, an easy connection table, step-by-step beginner instructions, complete code, functions and features, limitations, important notes to avoid mistakes, troubleshooting, and the four best-matching verified YouTube videos. The plugin states exactly what was checked and never claims unverified code is error-free.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this study material and give videos and notes PDFs for every heading.
Build an ESP32 temperature monitor with wiring table, code, and 4 videos.
Check my Arduino code for errors and give a fixed version with steps.
